narr: During the late evening of July 30, 2025, numerous thunderstorms developed over the Moneta area to the east of Shoshoni, WY and to the north of Highway 20/26. Radar derived rainfall estimates between 7 PM and 11 PM MDT were 2 to 3 inches, with an additional 1 inch of rainfall estimated the day before (July 29). This caused the highway culverts for Frenchie Draw to be overwhelmed. WYDOT employees at the time observed water 4 ft deep flowing across Highway 20/26 near Frenchie Draw, prompting a closure of the highway for approximately 2 hours, after which time water receded. WYDOT made repairs in Sep 2025 to backfill areas of washout along the road.
ev: WYDOT employee reported water was 4 feet deep flowing across the highway near Frenchie Draw. Water was on road for about 2 hours, which was the length of the closure. Damages estimated.
